Netzsch STA 449 F1 Jupiter Simultaneous Thermal Analyzer
The Netzsch STA 449 F1 Jupiter Simultaneous Thermal Analyzer features a temperature range of 150 °C to 1000 °C. For a given sample, this unit can simultaneously perform Thermal Analysis application of Thermogravimetry (TGA) and Differential Scanning Calorimetry (DSC). Please see manual.
Specifications/Capabilities
Weighing Range: 5000mg
TG Resolution: 0.025µg
DSC Resolution: >1µW
Temperature Range: -150°C to 1000°C
